description: This file is a shell script designed to initialize system components and configuration settings during system startup. It contains various setup routines such as permission adjustments, configuration resets, network parameter settings, and system event handling. The script orchestrates the startup process for a device, likely embedded or networking hardware, by executing commands, sourcing configuration files, and managing system services.

methods.name: changeFilePermissions
methods.description: Sets file permissions if the file exists and permissions differ from the specified value.

methods.name: CheckAndReCreateDB
methods.description: Checks NVRAM usage and recreates the syscfg database if NVRAM is full.
